title: One Stage Vertical Ridge Augmentation and Dental Implantation with Allograft Bonerings: Results One Year after Surgery
authors: Nord T, Yüksel O, Grimm WD, Giesenhagen B. J Oral Implantol. 2019;45(6):457-463
supports: Clinical study from the botiss maxgraft bonering (processed human allograft) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The allograft boneri ng technique was associated with a favorable outcome, and in cases with large vertical defects, both treatment time and donor site morbidity could be reduced” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
